title: Chapter 6975: A Brick Can Become An Immortal?

Chapter 6975: A Brick Can Become An Immortal?

Chapter 6975: A Brick Can Become An Immortal?

After sealing the monarch, Li Qiye patted the immortal bone. Immortal rays with a hint of blood pulsed outward. Despite the sanguine glow, they didn’t look creepy at all.

A beam from an unknown place with the same shade descended and initiated another maelstrom above Survivor Realm.

Everyone could see it and hid once more, instinctively afraid of destruction.

“That’s Heavenfall Path.” Tribulation Daoist remarked upon seeing the source of the beam.

The emperors stared at the bone in Li Qiye’s hand.

“According to the legend, the path is made from the celestial immortal’s body.” He continued.

“Senior, you told me Myriad Tribulations Immortal obtained the bone from the path.” Su Lianxin said.

“Yes, it didn’t cause as much of a stir.” Tribulation Daoist nodded.

“Must be harmonization.” Gold Talisman said.

“What should we do, Sir? I’m sure the outside immortals might come because of this.” Tribulation Daoist became worried.

“Already here.” Li Qiye glanced at the fortress.

Sure enough, rocks detached from the fortress and flew straight for them.

“We’re under attack!” The disciples became alarmed.

The emperors immediately initiated their defense. Unfortunately, these barriers were useless before the metallic rocks. The impact sent them flying while vomiting blood.

Five, in particular, landed around Li Qiye.

“What are they?” Tribulation Daoist was surprised.

The five metals differed in both appearance and element.

One looked like a long slab meant for a wall. However, the surface resembled jade with a golden sheen. Another had the shape of a pillar - a perfect harmony between stone and bronze since its creation. One more looked like a radiant brick of gold.

“It’s Heavenfall’s bone.” The gold brick spoke, surprising everyone.

“Buzz.” The five entities activated their dao, overwhelming the emperors.

“O-Overlords...” The emperors stammered, startled at how bricks could become overlords.

“Then the immortals in the fortress...” Topknot Emperor stammered while staring at Tribulation Daoist.

If random blocks and metal pieces from the forces could become overlords, then their immortals must be out of this world.

“How do I know?” Tribulation Daoist shook his head.

“From Heavenly Fortress World, I see.” Li Qiye said.

“So you’re not from this world.” A voice came from above, accompanied by immortal sound waves.

“An immortal!” The group looked up and saw a crystal eaves-tile, not a radiant immortal as expected.
